steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each stakeholder is matched to a channel. One with no channel is a gap.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Stakeholder with no information need
findings.fix: Record what this stakeholder needs to know

findings.title: Stakeholder with no channel
findings.fix: Name the channel and the frequency

findings.title: Need with no owner
findings.fix: Assign an owner for the update

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

[medium] stk-vendor:19  Stakeholder with no channel.
       Fix: Name the channel and the frequency.
[low] stk-team:26  Need with no owner.

Not checked: Stakeholders not on the list.
pros: Checks a stakeholder with no information need, a stakeholder with no channel, and a need with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Stakeholders not on the list.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-stakeholder-plan skill on the records for this review.
